verdict.rationale: Open-source availability of a GPU's software stack, such as drivers, firmware or SDKs, is a fair question for a graphics card, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions any source code published under an open license for the RTX 5090 or its drivers. The CUDA Toolkit, DLSS and SDK items describe developer tooling and features, not openly licensed source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
